 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Uday Pratap Singh

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUNIL KUMAR PANWAR  ORAL ORDER 4 20-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner is languishing in custody in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 447, 376, 511, 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4/6 of the POCSO Act.

It is alleged against the petitioner that the petitioner in drunken condition entered into the house of the informant and made an attempt to ravish her and when the informant raised alarm, other family members Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.56580 of 2022(4) dt.20-06-2023 wake up and apprehended the petitioner.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
The petitioner and the informant were in love with each other and on call of the informant, the petitioner went in the house of the informant when he was seen by the grand-mother of the informant.
Hence, in order to save her skin, this false case has been registered by the informant.
The call details of the informant suggests that she called eight times on the alleged date and time on the mobile of the petitioner.

Moreover, the victim girl is major, hence, the offence Niraj Kumar @ Niraj Ray vs The State Of Bihar on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131859859/
1 under the POCSO Act is not made out against the petitioner.
